bindingType.description: The binding type of the Estimate. Refer to /Estimating/Binding/Types for valid values.

effectiveDate.description: Date when the estimate should be rated for.

estimateDate.description: Date when the estimate was created.

isAvailMove.description: A value indicating whether the estimate is an Avail move.

isSelfHaul.description: A flag that specifies whether the estimate is for a self haul shipment.

createdBy.description: The email address of the person who created the estimate.

updatedBy.description: The email address of the person who updated the estimate.

linehaulDiscountPercent.description: Percentage discount to be applied to linehaul. Valid Range is 0 to 100.

businessLineType.description: The business line type of the estimate.

poNumber.description: The PO number associated with the estimate.

storageDiscountPercent.description: Percentage discount to be applied to storage. Valid Range is 0 to 100.

tariffName.description: Tariff of the estimate. Refer to /Estimating/Tariffs for valid values.

businessId.description: BusinessId of the Customer on estimate.

title.description: Title the estimate should be know as.

useContainerCapacityWeight.description: Indicates if weight is determined by container weight.

hubspotContactId.description: Reference identity to associated HubSpot move.

hubspotMoveId.description: Reference identity to associated HubSpot move.

breakpointWeight.description: The breakpoint weight of the estimate. If shipment weight exceeds value, then different rates may apply.

taxExemptions.description: Indicates applied tax exemptions to the estimate.

leadSourceType.description: The lead source the customer originated from.

leadSourceOther.description: Indicates a custom lead source the custmer originated from.

excludedImpliedServices.description: List of implied services to exclude from rating.

description.description: The description of the line item.

discountAmount.description: The total amount of all discounts applied to the line item.

netCharge.description: The charge for the line item after all discounts have been applied.

netChargePercentage.description: The percentage of the rating's Net charge that the line item comprises.

weight.description: The weight being stored in MiniStorage.

isOvertime.description: Indicator if this job is done on overtime hours.

isOvertime.description: Specifies whether the packing service was performed during overtime.

type.description: Type of the Packing. Refer to /Estimating/Packing/Types for valid values.

cartons.description: The collection of cartons that were handled while the packing service was performed.

agreedFromDate.description: The start of the date range for performing the packing service.

agreedToDate.description: The end of the date range for performing the packing service.

schedule.description: The pack schedule to use for rates. Refer to /Estimating/Packing/Schedules for valid values.

note.description: Notes in regards to the Phone.

type.description: Type of the Phone. Refer to /Estimating/Phone/Types for valid values.

performedByAgentCode.description: The Agent code of the Agent performing the survey.

performedDateTime.description: DateTime of when the survey was performed.

performedBySalesPersonEmail.description: The SalesPerson Email of who performed the survey.

method.description: The method of how the survey was performed.

remit.description: A description of the pricing method's remit.

valuation.description: A description of the valuation applied by the pricing method.

billingTariff.description: The billing tariff specified by the pricing method.

valuationSummary.description: A description of the valuation specified by the pricing method.

allowsGrossPricing.description: A value indicating whether the pricing method allows for gross pricing.

allowsSeparatedFirstFinalMileCharges.description: A value indicating whether the pricing method allows for First/Final Mile Charges to be separated.

flatRateAutoChargesApply.description: A value indicating whether flat rate auto charges apply to the pricing method.

requiresReservation.description: A value indicating whether the pricing method requires a reservation.

rate.description: The valuation rate specified by the pricing method.

lineItems.description: The collection of the line items included in the rating.

properties.description: A key/value collection of arbitrary properties associated with the rating.
